text:
morgan: quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone status please. shamelessly short: what shipped, what slipped, immediate owner for next action, and any CRs you want eyes on. tagging eng + product leads.

anya: shipped: payments-fastpath + logging opt-in (PR#4821). owner: anya. no blockers. :tada:

raj: slipped: runtime v2 rollout for low-latency routing — hit an unexpected perf regression in kv-cache. root cause suspected kernel path under certain seq lengths. owner: raj + eng-runtime. next step: rollback canary to v1 for heavy API routes, patch branch open.

morgan: @raj can you drop the rollback steps here and a quick ETA? also list any customers impacted.

raj: rollback steps: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:v1.9.3 && rollout status deploy/runtime`
Estimated ETA: 2-3 hours once infra approves. Impacted: two internal test fleets + a handful of early Dedicated beta customers (will notify via email).

leo: slipped: docs portal refresh (was aiming to ship today) — blocked by final API changelog from product. owner: leo. ETA EOD tomorrow.

tess: shipped: A/B rollout for prefix caching heuristics to 50% — looks stable. owner: tess. small perf win on average latency ~6%.

priya: blocker: security review backlog — need one more sign-off for Private deploy bundle. owner: priya. can anyone from infra pick up the review? @cory?

cory: I can take the review in the next 4 hours. pinged in the compliance thread.

jamie: quick CR pings: please review these when you have a min —
- PR#4902 (runtime: kv-cache fix) — @raj @tess
- PR#4910 (console: rollout UI tweaks) — @leo @anya
- PR#4918 (dedicated: autoscale policy docs) — @priya @cory

anya: will do PR#4910 now.

tess: taking PR#4902. can we add a simple unit test to exercise the seq-length branch? currently manual repro only.

raj: adding test in branch now. will push in ~30m.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canaries are at 15% for runtime:v2. Health checks stable for 12m.

morgan: ok — action items summary: rollback runtime canary if perf regression persists (owner: raj + infra), PR reviews (owners above), docs finish (leo), security review (cory). I’ll consolidate into the OKR tracker after lunch. if anything urgent escalate in #eng-oncall. thanks all :handshake:

priya: FYI — tagging legal for the Private bundle sign-off so we can close the compliance checklist.

cory: started review, flagged one minor key-rotation doc gap. will resolve with priya.

morgan: sweet. last ask — if you’ve got any customer-impact notes pls drop as one-liners here so I can include in the postmortem if we need one.

raj: customer note: Dedicated beta going to see degraded 95th p99 for requests with seq > 2048 until patch lands. sending email to beta list now.

leo: note: docs delay only affects new dev onboarding pages, not API reference.

anya: no customer impact for payments-fastpath rollout.

morgan: perfect. I’ll close this thread after I add entries to the OKR doc. thanks everyone :v:
